review_notes: Inspected all 77 lines, the relevant point constructions, Surface and centre definitions, chart lemmas, and downstream uses. One straightforward structural generalisation is supported. No Lean execution was performed; the proposed replacement is not compilation-tested.

findings.excerpt:
lemma affineComplexPoint_not_mem_basicOpen (S : Surface) (U : S.scheme.affineOpens)
    (ρ : letI := (openScalars S.structureMap U.1).toAlgebra;
      Γ(S.scheme,U.1) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ) (t : Γ(S.scheme,U.1)) (ht : ρ t = 0) :
    (affineComplexPoint S.structureMap U ρ).left (fieldPoint ℂ) ∉ S.scheme.basicOpen t := by
findings.problem: The Surface parameter requires integrality, smooth relative dimension two, and a projective embedding, whereas this vanishing criterion only needs an arbitrary scheme over ℂ. The underlying affineComplexPoint construction already has that generality.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace the statement with:
lemma affineComplexPoint_not_mem_basicOpen {X : Scheme.{0}} (f : X ⟶ complexBase)
    (U : X.affineOpens)
    (ρ : letI := (openScalars f U.1).toAlgebra; Γ(X,U.1) →ₐ[ℂ] ℂ)
    (t : Γ(X,U.1)) (ht : ρ t = 0) :
    (affineComplexPoint f U ρ).left (fieldPoint ℂ) ∉ X.basicOpen t
The existing proof works by replacing S.scheme with X and S.structureMap with f: the point corresponds to ker ρ, and fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen reduces membership to t ∉ ker ρ, contradicting ht. Update line 63 to pass S.structureMap. No nonemptiness assumption is necessary; t = 0 is covered, and unit t cannot satisfy ht.
findings.benefit: Makes the elementary vanishing criterion available for affine charts on complex curves, singular schemes, and nonprojective schemes without constructing an inapplicable Surface structure, while preserving the existing surface application.

  integral : IsIntegral scheme
  smooth : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 2 structureMap

  embedding : scheme ⟶ complexProjectiveSpace embeddingDimension
  closedImmersion : IsClosedImmersion embedding

theorem fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen :
    hU.fromSpec ⁻¹ᵁ X.basicOpen f = PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f := by
  rw [fromSpec_preimage_basicOpen', ← basicOpen_eq_of_affine]
